reference: Olkiluoto, Finland, crystalline bedrock (no published log for these boxes)

description.lithology: Migmatitic veined mica gneiss, mottled medium grey to white, medium- to coarse-grained, gneissic banded texture with irregular white quartz-feldspathic leucosome patches and streaks parallel to foliation, foliation/banding at low angle to core axis.
